summary: The audit checks 30 units of Linguistics (LINGUIST) courses: one introductory course each in phonetics/phonology, syntax and semantics/pragmatics, each letter graded, B or better, and taken for 4 units, with at least 20 of the 30 units in graduate courses numbered 200 or above and none below 100. Work out the rest of your courses in advance with your Linguistics minor advisor. Checked by hand: that program, the 3.0 overall GPA, that most of the 30 units are letter graded, and that no course also counts toward your PhD or another program. The research paper is optional.
